description: This Java class models the '<connection-factory>' configuration element within the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates the class attribute of the element, ensuring it is present and non-empty, and provides access to this attribute.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: A final class representing the '<connection-factory>' element in the entity configuration, ensuring thread safety and immutable class name.

methods.name: ConnectionFactory(Element)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConnectionFactory object by reading the 'class' attribute from the provided XML Element, throwing an exception if missing or empty.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the connection factory.
